title: watch's first frame waits ~5s on terminals that ignore the colourscheme query
body:
On a pty that does not answer the OSC-11/DSR terminal query — script(1), plain ptys, CI drivers, some multiplexers — `ticfac watch` writes the query at +0.02s and then draws nothing until the query's ~5-second read times out (+5.18s measured), before the first frame renders. The bare `ticfac` overview renders instantly on the same terminal, so the block is specific to the watch's start. A person opening a watch in a pane that does not answer sees five seconds of blank screen — the exact first-frame class #112/z7w's property targets, and the reason the suite's bound cannot honestly be tighter than 5s. The wait is in the colorscheme detection the cobra wrapper performs at command start (fang/colorprofile), so a fix means bounding or skipping that query for the live view.
evidence: internal/cli/root.go:28 (the colorprofile writer); pty drive: query bytes at +0.02s, first frame at +5.18s, while `ticfac --repo <world>` renders at once on the same pty
